name: BSP_UnitInstance_GetHealth
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. float __thiscall(this), RET 0, body 00923BE0..00923C4B. Returns 0.0f while the +5Dh gate is set (00923BE4), otherwise the virtual at vtable +110h floored at zero, with the zero also written back to +164h (00923C16). 00956600 compares its result against +364h to drive the descriptor damage-threshold scan. docs/UNIT_TIMED_SUBUPDATES.md

name: BSP_UnitController_UpdateStub
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Body 0092BE80..0092BE82 is one instruction, RET 4: void __thiscall(controller, float delta) that does nothing. Called directly (non-virtually) from 008259DF (step 6 of 008255B0) and 00826B6A, so no override can intercept it. docs/UNIT_CONTROLLER_UPDATE.md.

name: BSP_UnitController_GetBodyAxisSpeed
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. float __thiscall(controller), RET 0, body 0092D730..0092D76E, result on the x87 stack. body=controller->p_2Ch; axis=00C32000(body); v=00C31F40(body,&scratch); return (v[1]*axis[1Ch] + v[0]*axis[18h]) + v[2]*axis[20h]. axis+18h..+20h is the third 12-byte row, so this is a signed speed along one body axis. Whole sum stays on the x87 stack and is rounded once at 0092D765. 28 callers including 008255B0, 008252C0 and 00834E90. docs/UNIT_TIMED_SUBUPDATES.md
